events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: An Empire for a Ring

options.text: I will not be blackmailed, especially not by my own family.
Very well, [character]. You win this time.

events.text: Betrayal hurts. But betrayal from family? That wounds. Your Slighted son [character] has been writing to [character], culminating with him sending a loyal eunuch to deliver his ring to the leader of the [tribe], along with a request for aid against your rule. Now a [tribe] ambassador stands before you repeating [character] demands: [character] is to wed [character] and be returned to his titles. Refusal will mean war.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: An Unlikely Match

options.text: Our people do not wed [tribe].
We will consider a match... in time.
We cannot risk the [tribe]'s wrath. The [family] family will accept a match.

events.text: The [tribe] ruler insists that we will not know peace unless one of our nobles marries one of his people. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Annexation

options.text: Tell him to take what is rightfully ours.
We do not wish to further anger the [tribe].

events.text: Recent skirmishes along the border have left a strip of habitable land unprotected. [character], a great soldier, proposes that we annex the region for further development. This move could potentially alienate the nearby [tribe] but it would enlarge our borders significantly.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Choosing Sides

options.text: If the [tribe] want a fight, then we will give it to them.
We will join in their campaign against the [tribe].

events.text: While the ancient hostility between the [tribe] and the [tribe] is not new to us, we hesitate to choose sides. However, a messenger from the [tribe] has arrived, exclaiming that the time for neutrality is over. They demand that we join them in battle against the [tribe] at once.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Choosing Sides

options.text: We side with civilization against the barbarous [tribe].
[rival] lands are ripe for conquest!

events.text: War has broken out among the [tribe] and the [rival]. This conflict is on our very doorstep, and as such there can be no neutral course of action. We must choose a side!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Dangerous Friendship

options.text: Threaten hostilities if the [tribe] do not expel all [rival].
Order [character] to cease all relations with [rival].

events.text: Our spies in the nearby [tribe] encampments report a rise in the number of foreign visitors, most notably [rival] soldiers. This suggests a possible alliance between the [tribe] and [rival]. Such a partnership would threaten us at every turn. We suggest reaching out to [character] to mend your ailing relationship.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Desperate Messenger

options.text: Let us repel the [tribe] together.
[rival] will face this threat alone.

events.text: A messenger from the [tribe] arrives at court, wounded and breathless. They curse the [tribe] and say they escaped one of their raiding parties that was about to invade our lands. Eager to avenge old wrongs, the [tribe] will happily join us if we can supply their army. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Discerning Judgment

options.text: Convince both parties to share responsibility.
Such barbarian nonsense is no concern of ours.

events.text: Two feuding [tribe] warlords have arrived at court seeking an impartial arbiter. They claim that violence will spill over into our lands if their conflict cannot be resolved. After explaining the intricacies of their dispute, they ask for a decision. What shall we suggest?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Distant Threats

options.text: Muster all available troops.
Increase national military training.

events.text: Raiding [tribe] hordes have been reported along our borders. This can only mean one thing: An invasion has begun! Our generals must rally to face the enemy. What shall they command?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Facing the Horde

options.text: I will ride out to meet the [tribe] myself.
Send a proxy in my stead.
Kill these [tribe] heathens.

events.text: A delegation from the murderous [tribe] tribe approaches the gates of the Capital. Their military prowess is legendary, and now their leader demands an audience with us! Our advisors suggest that you send a proxy, for your safety.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Florid Diplomat

options.text: Fine gifts may lead him to peace.
Let us test the strength of his people with weapons.

events.text: An influential [tribe] leader has arrived to inform us that his people are declaring war. As he lists their grievances, we cannot help but notice his rich clothing and eloquent rhetoric. Clearly, this is a man who appreciates the finer things...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Grave Offense

options.text: [character] must atone for his actions.
We will not suffer humiliation at the hands of the [tribe].

events.text: In a dramatic misunderstanding, [character] committed a grave offense against the [tribe]. They inform you that he must undergo ritual humiliation, or they will invade. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Invasion!

options.text: I must stay on the throne to maintain order.
A ruler belongs in the vanguard.

events.text: Unable to contain their fury, the [tribe] have launched an invasion of [rival] borderlands. While not shocking, this aggression is certainly unexpected, and our officers hurry to rally a resistance. Heir to the throne, [character], believes this defense requires the leadership of a [title], and he urges you to ride out with your soldiers.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Jealous Savage

options.text: The [tribe] have no say in my personal affairs.
As ruler, I have a right to any lover I choose.

events.text: [character] feels spurned by your lack of affections, and he has shared these sentiments with his relations among the [tribe]. Blood ties run deep among their people, and they vow to not let the arrogant leader of the [nation] make a fool of their kin. There is talk of invasion, but the [tribe] are known to be unpredictable.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Large [tribe] Raid

options.text: Ready the ramparts! We shall weather the storm.

events.text: The [tribe] are utterly infuriated by you. Your haughty, superior attitude insults their noble barbarian dignity. The sight of your decadent menfolk arouses snickers among these weather-beaten savages. They cannot wait to feast upon the corpse of your civilization. Be forewarned, the [tribe] are assembling a grand warband that shakes the very ground!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Life is Short

options.text: We will pay for [character]'s safe return.
He is being punished for his carelessness.
I am exhausted by [character]'s impertinence.
[rival] wishes to ally with the [tribe].

events.text: On a recent diplomatic mission, [character] was waylaid by [tribe] warriors and captured. He now languishes in a dank prison, where his future remains in doubt. A message arrives from [character], with whom you have a tenuous relationship. "What shall I do with this lost son of [rival]? Life can be so short, so fragile."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Love or War

options.text: Ignore this madman's request.
Send him a polite refusal.

requirements.label: Schemer / Diplomat / Orator
tip: The leader must have one of: Schemer; Diplomat; Orator

options.text: Flatter him and keep him interested.

events.text: We have received a peculiar request from [character], [tribe] warlord. He demands that you submit to a marriage proposal and become his wife, or he and his [tribe] forces will declare war on [rival]. Shall we even acknowledge this absurd message?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: On the March

options.text: Devote all court resources to war.
Explore new weapons and tactics.

events.text: After a series of ominous threats, the powerful [tribe] have decided to declare war on us. We will meet this challenge as we do all others: together. First, we must...

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Past Imperfect Tense

options.text: This is absurd. [character] is not going anywhere.
[character] may claim to know nothing of this, but whether that is the truth or not, I will not fight a war for him.

events.text: Your [tribe] interpreter struggles. [character] is accusing [character] of... inappropriate relations? Involving [character], a priest among the [tribe]. The war party demands [character] return with them to face... another difficult to translate word.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Political Proposal

options.text: We agree to this union.
No, this match is unacceptable.
No, our [tribe] friends deserve better.

events.text: A festive caravan of [tribe] emissaries and servants arrive in the capital. Their leader, a woman in colorful robes, issues a demand that [character], your descendent, wed [character], chosen by the great [tribe] ruler, [character]. [character] will not be pleased, but there is more at stake than hurt feelings.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Power Broker

options.text: [character] is a good ally, and I trust him.
I wish to formalize our relationship.
Thank him, but we will handle the [tribe] ourselves.

events.text: As tensions with the [tribe] continue to grow, our advisors are at a loss for how to repair the relationship. However, a solution may have just arrived from your friend [character]. In a message from the [tribe] ruler, he offers to meet with the [tribe] on our behalf. The two tribes maintain good relations, and an endorsement from [character] could do wonders. Do we wish to involve ourselves so intimately in these barbarian relationships?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Ready for Anything

options.text: I have been privately preparing to conduct emergency training drills for our forces.
I have been seeking the council of our wisest ministers.
I have been studying the tactics our enemy has used historically to discover how to defeat them.

events.text: War has found you as you suspected it might. The [tribe] have been itching for a fight for some time, and for whatever reason, you are their chosen target. The full weight of their might is now bearing down upon you. Fortunately, having foreseen that this day might come, you have been quietly preparing. Now is the time to inform your Court what shape those preparations have taken.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Religious Raids

options.text: Refuse to make such a request.
Demand that the raids cease immediately.

events.text: The [tribe] have been growing bold of late, sending raiding parties across the border into [rival] land. But these raiders have not been targeting food stores or crops, rather [religion] temples, shrines and treasures. It seems they have been encouraged by their [religion] religion's anger at your recent actions. The demand that you make an ultimatum to get [character] to stop the raids, but such action is sure to direct their rage, and their swords, towards you instead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Risky Expedition

options.text: Now is not the time for war.
They are right to seize the opportunity.
We have been training for this.

events.text: The [family] family has sent a small expeditionary force to make an assault against the [tribe]. They wish to reap the glory from a march on the barbarian stronghold. Is this folly?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Sayer and Speaker

options.text: Take immediate action to prepare your defences.
Look to defend your cities with walls as the gods demand.
This is but a cry for attention.

events.text: Your attention has been brought to a commoner from [city], who claims that a divine voice has whispered to. This voice said that there is an imminent attack coming from the [tribe] and that [rival] should look to its walls for defense. Local magistrates have ignored the plea but some [religion] think this could be an omen sent by a protective god.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Scales of Tribute

options.text: We must swallow our pride and acquiesce.
Persuade him to accept a smaller amount.
Refuse his outrageous demands.

events.text: A hulking [tribe] champion bursts into court. Behind him, servants carry enormous rocks, which they heap onto a giant set of scales. He bellows that his warriors will destroy you unless you balance the weights with iron, food, and gold. What shall we do?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Take the Money and Run?

options.text: By all means. Let's get rich together!
Why split the profits when we can have it all? Ambush the [tribe] and the [rival] and take it for ourselves.
Hard pass. We'll sit this one out.

events.text: You and [character] have a shared love of all that glitters, so it is no great surprise to you when the leader of the [tribe] approaches you with an intriguing proposition. A shipment of goods belonging to [rival] will be traveling through lands near [tribe] territory. If you could see your way to help fund an operation, [tribe] raiders will hit the merchants and the two of you can split the proceeds. Interested?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Coming Tide

options.text: If they wish to fight, then we will fight.
Let the [tribe] come! We will be ready.

events.text: Refugees from [tribe] lands stream across our borders. This is a sure sign that the warring tribes of the [tribe] are on the march. We must act... Only two options face the court. We declare war on the [tribe] and ride out to meet them, or wait for the inevitable invasion.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tribal Envoy

options.text: Peace is worth the cost.
We will not be extorted by barbarians.

events.text: An envoy from the [tribe] comes before us, bearing a sword and an olive branch. He says that his people have fallen on difficult times, and they need our support to survive. If we provide aid, they will make peace. Otherwise, they will take what they need by force. How shall we respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tribal Invasion Threat

options.text: We have no choice.
Let them come!

requirements.label: Blessed / Bold / Warlike
tip: The leader must have one of: Blessed; Bold; Warlike

options.text: I think a quick display of our army's prowess should disuade such a plan.

events.text: Terrible news! The [tribe] threaten to invade unless we meet their demands. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tribal Migration

options.text: Allow them to settle and assimilate.
Persuade them to leave peacefully.
We must defend our lands from invasion.

events.text: Scouts report large numbers of [tribe] settlers crossing our borders in search of land. What shall we do?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tribal Threat

options.text: We have no choice.
Let them come!

events.text: [tribe] generals in bright, newly forged armor appear before the court. They bring a message: The [tribe] will declare war on us unless we pay the price.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Wagging the Dog

options.text: Thank him for informing you personally and tell him you'll see him on the field of battle.
Murder him. [character] was an idiot to have come to you under minimal guard.

requirements.label: Covert
tip: The leader must have Covert (a character trait)

options.text: Convince him that some of his own People are plotting to assassinate him and offer to assist in uncovering the plot.

events.text: Relations between your People and the [tribe] have been deteriorating for quite some time, so it's no great surprise when their leader, [character] appears before your Court, bristling with rage. "In coming to you personally, I pay you more respect than you deserve. Your Kingdom is at an end. My People will destroy you." You're not impressed by the display of bravado. How will you respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: War Preparations

options.text: Summon political support.
Rally the military.
Collect emergency taxes.

events.text: Without warning, the [tribe] have declared war! Advisors suggest a number of ways to prepare for the coming conflict. Which shall we choose?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Warbands

options.text: Muster all available troops.
Increase national military training.

events.text: Outraged by our actions, the [tribe] will no longer tolerate our presence in their lands. They have summoned their warbands and launched an invasion. We had best prepare for the coming battles.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Warlike Prince

options.text: Have [character] of the [tribe] tribe bring them a gift as a sign of our intentions.
Bribe the prince to tone down his rhetoric.
Prepare our people for war.

events.text: An outspoken [tribe] prince has raised his voice against our expansion, and he is rallying the people to war. What shall we do?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: [tribe] Raid

options.text: We will easily repulse these scurrilous dogs!

events.text: The [tribe] are beyond angry with you. They hold your so-called "Civilization" in utter contempt. The mere sight of you fills them with unbridled rage. As we speak, they are assembling their warbands. Soon they will conduct a substantial raid into your lands!

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: [tribe] Raid

options.text: Let them come!

events.text: The [tribe] cast a wary eye on your so-called "Civilization." They hold your decadent ways in contempt, and your recent insults, real or imagined, are the final provocation. They have sent a raiding party to teach you a lesson!
